regimens.dose_text: 200 mg taken concomitantly with each dose of carbidopa/levodopa, up to a maximum of 8 times daily (1600 mg/day). Levodopa dose may need reduction by 10-30% upon initiation to prevent dyskinesias. Harmless brownish-orange urine discoloration is common.

mechanism_of_action.value: Reversible and selective inhibitor of catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) in peripheral tissues, preventing the O-methylation of levodopa to 3-O-methyldopa (3-OMD) and increasing the area under the curve (AUC) of levodopa reaching the brain.
